text:
Predicates:
Affection(x) ::: x is some affection.
Love(x) ::: x is love.
Positive(x) ::: x is positive.
Premises:
Some affection is love ::: ∃x (Affection(x) ∧ Love(x))
Some love is positive ::: ∃x (Love(x) ∧ Positive(x))
Conclusion:
Some affection is positive ::: ∃x (Affection(x) ∧ Positive(x))
